factProposals.value: Cityworks is the legacy system; its SQL export is migrated into read-only history.
Permits, licenses, service requests, inspections and work orders are imported, with attachments stored, hash-verified and linked to their records.
Migrated cases are viewable for look-up on /history and clearly marked as historical and read-only.

decisions.statement: Cityworks history is read-only, enforced in the database.
decisions.rationale: allowed by REQ-012 and the safest cutover

decisions.statement: A migration is trusted only when record counts match and there are zero orphaned GIS links and zero unresolved links.
decisions.rationale: the story's trust criterion, made strict

decisions.statement: A rerun copies nothing already stored.
decisions.rationale: the migration must be safe to run twice

limitations.statement: Proven on a SIMULATED Cityworks export only; table and column names must be checked against the City's real export.
